description: Choose a currency, manage your data, and decide what stays in this browser.
currencyHelp: Values in other currencies need a rate you enter. We never refresh or guess them.
baseHelp: Your totals and reports are shown in this currency.
headerRateNeeded: To use {{currency}}, first add a manual exchange rate in Settings. Your base currency has not changed.
switchHelp: To switch to {{currency}}, first add a rate below. It must be stated as {{base}} per 1 {{currency}}.
ratesHelp: Use a statement or your own rate. Rates are shown as base currency per 1 unit of foreign currency.
noRates: No exchange rates entered. Foreign currency values will be left out of your totals until you add a rate.
localHelp: Your financial records are stored in this browser only. No accounts or connections are required.
backupHelp: Keep your own copy, or restore from a Falcon Eye JSON backup.
olderHelp: Import records from the earlier Falcon Eye portfolio, if available.
emptyOnly: Only available on an empty picture
originalPreserved: The original data is never removed or overwritten.
trySample: Try a sample or start fresh
sampleWarning: Samples are clearly marked and illustrative. Choose carefully—replacing records cannot be undone.
sampleHelp: Explore a populated view with example records and clearly labeled non-live values.
clearHelp: Remove your records and activities from this browser. Download a backup first if needed.
footnote: Changes stay in this browser, not in a cloud account. Clearing your browser storage may remove your data; use the backup option to keep a copy.
clearConfirmation: Clear the current financial picture from this browser? Download a backup first if you want one. This cannot be undone.
cleared: Your picture is now empty. Your older portfolio data, if any, is preserved.
sampleConfirmation: Replace your current financial picture with the clearly marked sample? Export a backup first if you want to keep these records.
legacyImported: Older records imported: {{count}}. Your original data remains untouched.
noLegacy: No older portfolio was available to import. Your current records were not changed.
restoreConfirmation: Replace the current picture with the data in this file? Export a backup first if you need these records.
saveFailed: That change could not be saved.
